blocks.text: Buying a Home in Maple Ridge, BC: Sub-Areas, Schools & Commuting

parts.t: Active MLS® listings in the City of Maple Ridge span 12 distinct sub-areas stretching from the Pitt River and Golden Ears Bridge in the west to Whonnock and the Mission border in the east. Buyers comparing urban convenience look to East Central and West Central around the Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney West Coast Express Station, while growing families target post-2000 detached homes and townhomes in Albion, Cottonwood, and Silver Valley.

Families across Maple Ridge are served by School District 42 (Maple Ridge-Pitt Meadows), including six public secondary schools (Maple Ridge Secondary with French Immersion, Westview, Thomas Haney, Samuel Robertson Technical, Garibaldi with IB, and Pitt Meadows Secondary) plus Early French Immersion at Eric Langton, Laity View, and Hammond Elementary.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, Transit-Oriented Areas & ALR Rules

parts.t: Property use in Maple Ridge is governed by Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan (Bylaw No. 7781-2021, adopted January 27, 2026), and Transit-Oriented Area Designation Bylaw No. 8001-2024 within 800 metres of Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station. Outside the Urban Area Boundary in Websters Corners, Thornhill, Northeast Maple Ridge, and Whonnock, buyers evaluate RS-2 (1-acre), RS-3 (2-to-5-acre), and Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) A-1, A-2, and A-3 zones alongside private wells and septic systems.

parts.t: How many neighbourhoods and MLS sub-areas are in Maple Ridge?

Maple Ridge is divided into 12 MLS® sub-areas: West Central, East Central, Southwest Maple Ridge (Hammond), Northwest Maple Ridge, Cottonwood, Albion, Silver Valley, Northeast Maple Ridge, North Maple Ridge, Websters Corners, Thornhill, and Whonnock. Compare all 12 on our
Which West Coast Express stations serve Maple Ridge commuters?
Maple Ridge is served by two West Coast Express commuter rail stations on the south side of town:
(20030 Dunn Ave in Southwest Maple Ridge) and
(22288 River Rd in East Central), connecting directly to Waterfront Station in downtown Vancouver.
Which SD42 schools offer French Immersion and IB in Maple Ridge?

In School District 42, Early French Immersion (K-7) is offered at Eric Langton Elementary, Laity View Elementary, and Hammond Elementary, continuing into Secondary French Immersion (8-12) at Maple Ridge Secondary (21911 122 Ave). The International Baccalaureate (IB) Career-related and Diploma Programme is offered at Garibaldi Secondary (24789 Dewdney Trunk Rd).

How do Transit-Oriented Areas and the Lougheed Corridor Plan affect Maple Ridge lots?

Under Transit-Oriented Area Designation Bylaw No. 8001-2024 and the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan (Bylaw No. 7781-2021, adopted January 27, 2026), parcels near Haney Transit Exchange, Port Haney Station, and along Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road carry multi-storey apartment and mixed-use density permissions.
